capabilities: Parse Markdown and generate WeChat-compatible inline HTML
Upload body images and cover images to WeChat
Create a WeChat Official Account draft
Import the note into a Feishu cloud document
Run one-click or one-sided syncs from the Obsidian command palette or the gz CLI
disambiguation: Not a vault or device syncing tool; it exports the current note to WeChat drafts and Feishu docs.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README stresses it only creates WeChat drafts and never auto-publishes, and warns against committing AppSecrets or config files to GitHub.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send notes to WeChat Official Accounts, whose draft API requires inline HTML and uploaded images, or to import them as Feishu cloud documents.

relations.evidence: syncs the current Markdown note to WeChat Official Account drafts and Feishu Docs
imports the same article into an online Feishu document

requires.name: Feishu self-built app App ID / App Secret

summary: Syncs the current Markdown note to a WeChat Official Account draft and a Feishu doc, converting Markdown to WeChat-compatible HTML via a local CLI.
